compiled_state.title: Smoke validation: run one instrumented bash block end-to-end and verify PRECONDITIONS degradation event
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD3: one forced fallthrough produces a PRECONDITIONS event with degradation:true and correct degradation_type verifiable in the ticket system

## What
Select one instrumented fallthrough site (recommend: sprint/SKILL.md). Extract its bash block. Run it directly with test parameters. Verify the PRECONDITIONS event appears in the ticket show output with degradation:true and the correct degradation_type.

## Integration Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given: sprint/SKILL.md has been instrumented with an EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark and bash block (T4 complete)
When: the bash block is extracted and executed directly with a test ticket ID and session parameters
Then: the ticket show for that test ticket contains a PRECONDITIONS event with data.degradation=true and correct degradation_type matching the inventory

## Test Execution Steps
1. Create a test ticket: TEST_TICKET=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket create task smoke-test-preconditions-degradation --parent=3346-0c82 --priority=4 2>/dev/null)
2. Extract the bash block from the instrumented sprint/SKILL.md site
3. Execute the bash block with TEST_TICKET substituted for ticket ID
4. Verify via: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show $TEST_TICKET and inspect preconditions_summary
5. Clean up: .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition $TEST_TICKET in_progress closed

## Integration Exemption
Full behavioral verification requires actual ticket system execution. Integration exemption criterion: behavioral correctness requires real boundary execution with no feasible unit-level mock.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bash block from an instrumented site executes without error (exit 0 or || true masks error)
  Verify: grep -A10 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md | grep 'preconditions-record' | head -1 | bash && echo 'block executed'
- [ ] PRECONDITIONS event with degradation event type appears in ticket system for test ticket
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show $TEST_TICKET | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ps=d.get("preconditions_summary",{}); print(ps)'
- [ ] data.degradation=true in event data
  Verify: (inspect preconditions_summary from ticket show for degradation field)
- [ ] data.degradation_type in {inferred_decision, unresolved_question}
  Verify: (inspect preconditions_summary from ticket show for degradation_type field)
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user

GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: T6 must create a reusable smoke test script (not just procedural verification). Add to acceptance criteria:

- [ ] tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke.sh created and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke.sh
- [ ] .test-index entry added mapping smoke test to the source skill file used in the test
  Verify: grep -q 'test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke' .test-index
- [ ] Smoke test script exits 0 when bash block runs successfully (CI-repeatable)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-smoke.sh

Rationale: DD3 requires 'verifiable in ticket system' which implies repeatability. The SC3 hook and future CI regression checks need a CI-runnable script, not one-time manual verification.
